verdict.rationale: Stagehand's user-data best-practices page documents a persistent user data directory. It is created if missing and left in place after shutdown, so the next run starts with the same cookies and local storage. For hosted sessions, Browserbase contexts persist browser data, which together cover reusable logged-in state across runs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that saved sessions actually bypass login walls, and explicit documentation of named or multiple profile management beyond a single directory or context.
